modifications: Preserve the real launch/doctor/drive/evidence/cleanup workflow and complete feature inventory; retain missing-precondition and all-entry-point safeguards.

Keep authorization, incomplete execution and raw Codex metadata-validator incompatibility explicit.
Preserve upstream MIT attribution and per-file original/adapted byte digests.
required_tools: Agent harness with explicit skill invocation or approved loading
Git and repository-native build/test/verification tools selected by the target skill

verification.raw_quick_validate: Rejected retained upstream disable-model-invocation; temporary projection omits only that field. Distributed field and validator remain unchanged.

reproducible_payload_audit.setup: Use separate clean checkouts: the exact tool commit and this package source commit. These independent draft branches are not merged.
reproducible_payload_audit.scope: Worktree inventory/hash/license consistency only; not Git tracking or source authentication.

verification.shared_ci_dependency: https://github.com/bajor/github-workflows/pull/9 must be approved/deployed separately and current skill heads rerun; present phone-scanner failure is not waived.

digest_scope: SHA-256 of every packaged file except provenance.json; upstream digest maps LICENSE to repository root LICENSE.
intended_platforms: Windows when target verification tools support it
integrity_authority: Same-file digests detect accidental drift only. Authenticating the whole package requires an approved external source/tree pin; that distribution infrastructure is not implemented here.
